method: Every listed physical page individually inspected through tools.view_image at original PNG resolution, using the fresh immutable system Poppler 150 dpi renders. Checked readable two-page table of contents, page-number typography, flow, clipping, crowding, margins and headers/footers. Separately checked all 87 TOC PDF link annotations on physical pages 4 and 5 have in-document page targets in the 70-page PDF.
observations: Physical page 3 contains no PDF link annotations. It was inspected for its actual opening-text content and clean layout. The assignment expectation of forward links on this page was reported to root rather than claimed as verified.
The final contents continuation fits on physical page 5 without the sparse third contents page from the earlier 71-page version.
